messages.author: 6f17ff4d1bfe11d7
messages.subject: Factor variable for joint models
parts:
Hi everyone,

If I fit a model with a factor variable (R) in a joint model, how can I use two intercepts as reference levels of the two distributions?

R.z = as.factor(R, rep(NA,n))
R.y = as.factor(rep(NA,n), R)

This gives only one intercept
y ~ R.z + R.y 

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Factor variable for joint models
parts:
remove the default intercept and add your own.

intercept <- as.factor(rep(1:2, each=length(R))

and then do

y ~ -1 + intercept + ....
